race.comment: Open little race with the favourite coming out. STAR JE TAIME (11) resumes. She was thought highly enough of to run in a G3 on debut, not firing behind Satono Glow. She's since trialled nicely and should be a sharp improver at each way odds. STIPULATION (12) was behind the scratched favourite PLATINUM PEARL on debut but did start shorter than that filly before bumping into a good one at Sandown Hillside last time. Sets up very well on speed now and should go close. DELAHRA (2) is off a break but has ability, watch for her hitting the line. ROEBUCK PLANE (9) has been good in two runs to date in NSW and will give a sight up on speed.
